recentItems.title: Sul Kyung-gu, Jeon Do-yeon & Lee Chang-dong on 'Possible Love''s Ten Year Journey
recentItems.description:
Stars Sul Kyung-gu, Jeon Do-yeon, and director Lee Chang-dong sit down with Rotten Tomatoes editor Jacqueline Coley to discuss their romantic drama, 'Possible Love'!  They share the inspirations for the long-time project, the complex emotions that went into the script, and how the cast and directors relied on each other to bring the story to life.  See 'Possible Love' in theaters October 23 and on Netflix November 6!
